{"metadata":{"description":"DSH SuperAdvisor: on-demand second opinions from a stronger model, with editable requests and per-call human approval.","id":"gh:1362142284","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-super-advisor","slug":"kvmem/dsh-super-advisor","topics":["advisor","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","superadvisor"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH SuperAdvisor: on-demand second opinions from a stronger model, with editable requests and per-ca"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"on-demand second opinions from a stronger model, with editable requests and per-call human approval."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH SuperAdvisor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An independent, on-demand advisor tool for DeepSeek Harness. The main model calls `ask_advisor`, the"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" saved approval policy permits the request, and the advisor returns text advice for the main model t"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"o verify and act on."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Source: kvmem/dsh-super-advisor. This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that uses DSH's existing model, p"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ermission, and approval services."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Version `0.1.8` adds verified compatibility with five DSH releases and Node 22.19+, and fixes select"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ion of Code Mode tool-result evidence on DSH 0.1.5. See the compatibility matrix. These changes requ"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ire the 0.1.8 package; an existing 0.1.7 installation is unchanged."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Version `0.1.7` renames this project from **DSH Advisor** to **DSH SuperAdvisor**, with package name"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" `dsh-super-advisor`. Existing users should follow the upgrade instructions. The `ask_advisor` tool,"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" saved model settings, and audit records remain compatible."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Version `0.1.6` makes plugin output limits optional. New installations inherit the selected DSH mode"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"l service's token budget and impose no local response-size cap. Existing custom limits are preserved"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"; both can be disabled in **Output settings (`输出设置`)**. Model/service limits, available resources, a"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nd the request timeout still apply."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Version `0.1.5` fixes silent save blocking in the advisor settings card. Invalid drafts now show a s"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"pecific explanation, and clicking Save focuses that explanation without writing settings. Disabled b"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"uttons have a distinct appearance, and an unchanged form explains that there is nothing to save."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Approve all consultations (0.1.11)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In **Settings → Plugins → DSH SuperAdvisor → Approval mode (`审批方式`)**, select **Approve all (`全部自动批准"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"（无额外调用）`)** and save. This explicitly authorizes all valid consultations to the displayed advisor de"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"stination, including `requires_human_approval: true`, absent labels, and requests with local sensiti"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ve-content warnings. No reviewer call or per-request confirmation is needed. The result card and aud"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"it record identify this policy as `always`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Existing redaction still runs. DSH file/command permissions, host `approval: never`, cancellation, c"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"onfiguration validation, call limits and send-once auditing remain effective. Changing the destinati"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"on skips the consultation with `review_required` until the new destination is saved; it does not ope"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"n a confirmation dialog or retry. This approves sending selected text, not executing operations disc"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"alog or retry. This approves sending selected text, not executing operations discussed in that text."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Fresh installations remain manual, and upgrades preserve the saved mode. Switch back to another appr"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"oval mode and save to disable approve-all. Saving settings does not call a model. This feature requi"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"res version **0.1.11** built from source or its package."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Main-model tag approval (0.1.10)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Development version **0.1.10** adds **Settings → Plugins → DSH SuperAdvisor → Approval mode (`审批方式`)"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" → Main-model tag (`主模型标注（无额外调用）`)**. Select this mode and save to authorize the displayed advisor d"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"estination. No reviewer model needs to be configured. Existing saved modes are preserved; fresh inst"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"allations remain manual."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The main model includes `requires_human_approval` in the **same `ask_advisor` tool call** as the que"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"stion and selected evidence:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `false`: ordinary authorized text consultation; send directly after local checks.
- `true`: ask a "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"human, or skip this consultation under the saved fallback.
- Missing label: use the same human/skip "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"fallback. Invalid types are rejected rather than coerced."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- The main model explicitly supplies a question, goal, constraints, attempted actions and their resu"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"lts, and up to eight evidence items.
- File evidence uses the existing DSH `read` tool's permission "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"and execution pipeline. Tool-result evidence must come from completed calls in the current task.
- O"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"nly the selected text line ranges are included. Full conversations, system history, images, and hidd"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"en reasoning are not automatically attached.
- Native user-question cards show the destination, prov"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ider/model, output limit, and all system instructions and request text that will be sent.
- Users ca"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"n replace the question, goal, constraints, attempts, or individual evidence text, and can delete evi"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"dence. Edits generate a new preview that requires a separate approval.
- Each approval is bound to a"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"n immutable snapshot. The optional AI review issues a snapshot-bound approval; fabricated `approved`"},{"id":"p22s10","text":" arguments and unrelated automatic approvals cannot authorize a request.
- Each request calls DSH's "},{"id":"p22s11","text":"`PreparedLlmCall.stream` once, without automatic retries or provider switching. Timeouts and interru"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"ptions return explicit statuses.
- A send marker is persisted before the call starts. Re-entering th"},{"id":"p22s13","text":"e same task and call reuses a saved result or refuses to send again."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Verified on **Linux with a local POSIX filesystem**, using **Node 22.19.0, 22.23.2, 24.2.0, and 24.1"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"9.0**, with DSH **`0.1.2-alpha.4`, `0.1.2-alpha.5`, `0.1.2-rc.1`, `0.1.3-alpha.2`, and `0.1.5-alpha."},{"id":"p24s3","text":"1`**. Peer dependencies explicitly accept these releases; development dependencies stay pinned for r"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"eproducible builds. Older DSH releases have confirmed API incompatibilities or dependency resolution"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" failures. See the matrix, limitations, and test commands."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Model access uses DSH's `provider + model` routing and `ctx.llm.prepareCall`. The plugin has no sepa"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rate HTTP client, does not manage model deployment, and does not require an OpenAI-compatible API. D"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"SH adapters use the protocols they support."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The selected provider must be registered in `listConfigurableProviders()`, and its **DSH provider co"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"nfiguration must explicitly set `baseURL`**. The URL must not contain a username, password, query pa"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"rameters, or fragment. Credentials remain managed by DSH's adapter/credentials services, not by this"},{"id":"p26s4","text":", or fragment. Credentials remain managed by DSH's adapter/credentials services, not by this plugin."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"For example, `llm-deepseek` uses `baseURL` at the configuration root; `llm-pi-ai` uses `providers.<y"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"our-provider>.baseURL`. Third-party adapters must honor DSH's call-snapshot contract, avoid uploadin"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"g task data during preparation, and avoid automatic internal retries within a single stream."}],"truncated":true}
